references.text: Daniel prophesied about a time when the end would come, which can be seen as related to Jesus' announcement that the time is fulfilled.
Joel speaks of the outpouring of God's Spirit in the last days, which can be connected to the inauguration of God's kingdom that Jesus speaks of.
John the Baptist calls for repentance because the kingdom of heaven is near, which resembles Jesus' message.
Jesus begins his preaching by saying that the kingdom of heaven is near, which directly mirrors Mark 1:15.
Jesus preaches about God's kingdom and calls for repentance, parallel to Mark 1:15.
Jesus speaks of the necessity of being born again to see God's kingdom, which can be connected to the themes of repentance and faith in Mark 1:15.
